supports: Local law enforcement working with ICE
positions.quote: Blakeman said NO to Kathy Hochul’s sanctuary policies, and worked with ICE to take criminals off our streets.
positions.impact: State and local police would likely cooperate more closely with federal immigration enforcement. Limits on that cooperation under current state policy could be rolled back.

supports: A strict approach to enforcing laws against crime
positions.quote: Blakeman has a no-nonsense approach to fighting crime.
positions.impact: Expect an emphasis on police staffing and enforcement. His campaign points to hiring more than 900 police and law enforcement officers as County Executive.

supports: Tax relief for homeowners and renters
positions.quote: As Governor, he will deliver real relief to homeowners and renters - just as he did as County Executive.
positions.impact: Expect proposals aimed at lowering property-related costs for homeowners and renters. As County Executive he held county property taxes flat, according to his campaign.
